title: 卓上湿式タイル切断機
description: 水受けトレーと2本のレール上のスライドベッドを備える小型タイル切断機。片持ち支柱、放熱フィン付きモーター、固定刃と上部ガード、定規、ポンプ筐体、給水ホースを造形。タイル、水、架台、切断・回転・給水動作は付属しません。作業用機械や安全規格適合品ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.879 × 0.739 × 0.751 m、15,248三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A compact tabletop wet tile saw with open reservoir, twin guide rails and sliding-bed geometry. Models a cantilever column, finned motor, fixed blade and upper guard, fence, pump casing and water hose. No tile, water, separate stand, cutting, rotation or water-flow behavior is supplied. It is not a working machine or safety-standard-certified product. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.879 × 0.739 × 0.751 m; 15,248 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
